nom: Personal Day Just Like New Adapinoid Serum

segments.sensitive: An unusually large number of reviewers describe their skin as sensitive or reactive to retinoids, and nearly all report this serum is gentle with little to no irritation, stinging, or burning, several replacing prescription tretinoin or adapalene with it; one notes an initial purge before her skin improved.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, many managing hormonal or cystic acne, report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and faster healing of active blemishes, several saying it succeeded after prescription retinoids failed; a few say they saw no real difference, and one with clog-prone skin found the squalane in the formula caused clogging.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading dark spots, acne marks, or hyperpigmentation with continued use, describing gradual but consistent improvement over several weeks.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers who say other retinoids damaged or irritated their skin barrier report this serum feels protective and calming instead.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says it helped reduce both dark spots and redness left by her acne.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers also noticed softer fine lines or forehead creases alongside their other improvements.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says it cleared congestion in her T-zone, while another with clog-prone skin found the squalane in the formula caused clogging and advises caution for those prone to clogged pores.

aspects.libelle: Dropper frequently fails to draw product
Thick formula gets stuck in the dropper
Product goes to waste from packaging
A little goes a long way
Gentler than prescription retinoids or adapalene

extraits.texte: I somehow missed that this has squalane which clogs my skin so much, but gave 3 stars bc the texture & product itself is nice but if you're super clog prone then dont risk.
Took a pretty long time to ship, plus the applicator didn't work. I don't think it broke me out, which is very good, but I don't think it did much either.

For the last 8-9 months I have been struggling with my acne and the dark acne scars it leaves on my face. I have tried everything from renewing old prescriptions from other brands that tailor your acne treatment to your skin type but none of them worked. I finally came across this product and I decided to try it, especially because my skin is extremely sensitive. Not only has this serum made my dark acne scars slowly start to fade, but my acne has cleared up almost completely. I also did not have a reaction to it like I have with other products so I practically cried when I noticed it. This came out at a great time and I signed up for the subscription because I KNOW I have FINALLY found something that works for me!

extraits.titre: Where has this been all my adult life?
extraits.texte: Retinoids have always wrecked my skin barrier and I have never been able to use them frequently enough to see any progress. So this serum is an ABSOLUTE GAME CHANGER. My skin is glowing, clear, and hydrated. Dark spots that have been so stubborn are visibly better every week. My skin hasn't looked this good... Ever?? Can't recommend this highly enough.

I recently started incorporating the adapinoid serum into my routine and have noticed such a big difference in my skin. My hyperpigmentation spots have started fading and my skin looks so much more even and smooth. I've even noticed some of forehead creases being not as visible as before. I also really love that its really gentle on my skin. Usually my skin is so sensitive so introducing new products is really a gamble for me, but my skin has taken really well to this new product and I have not had any dryness or irritation. Would definitely recommend. I even had a coworker of mine mention how much better my skin has looked recently and asking for my routine!

Product itself is AWESOME. Great for super sensitive skin, everything else I've tried has been far too harsh on my skin. However, the packaging. While cute… it's extremely hard to get the product out after a certain amount of use. I've had to take the stopper out and shake the product out. A more fiction tube style packaging would be more functional and allow the user to use all the product instead of wasting the rest and having to buy a new one. PLEASE CHANGE THE PACKAGING!!!!

I've been using it for a few weeks now and I can tell it's helped with some acne dark spots and redness!! If I have a bad skin picking session I slap a tiny bit on and by the morning my skin is looking clear again.
